note: FREE PLAN: game-total odds fetched at most once per league per UTC day. Sportsbook team-total requests disabled; team-score projections remain available when history matches. NBA/NFL player-prop automatic refreshes are paused; manual runs still spend credits. Experimental recent-score model, not backtested; no pace, injury, weather or schedule-strength adjustments. NBA/NFL: up to 8 games in the next 7 days. NCAAF: all games in the next 7 days. NCAAB: all games in the next 24 hours. Decimal odds. Cached odds retain sportsbook timestamps and may be stale. A 25-credit reserve pauses further requests after a low balance is reported.
